details.body:
This document tells you how much it costs to apply for a UK visa and includes previous fees. It shows fees for all visas including:

  • visitor
  • work
  • student
  • settlement
  • naturalisation

For previous versions of the visa fees tables, see the National Archives.

Use the visa fees tool to check the cost of your visa in the country you’re in.
